description: This Java class 'DateUtil' provides utility methods for date formatting, parsing, and date calculations within the project. It includes methods for generating timestamps, formatting dates in various string formats, adding days to the current date, and processing posted date parameters from HTTP requests.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: Utility class for date formatting, parsing, and computation functions used across the project.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp in 'yyyyMMddHHmmSS' format based on the current date and time.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a given Date object into a string using the default date format specified in Constants.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a Date object to extract the year component as a string.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a long date string with day, date, month, year, time, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string with format 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object using the default date format.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current date plus a specified number of days.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HTTP request to set start and end dates.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date as a Date object.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date as a Date object.
